Pass 2 - re-encode first frame at upscaled size

widgets_values:
TEST WORKFLOW: same rendering graph as the I2V 2 Pass API version.

1. Upload / choose your FIRST FRAME image.
2. Enter an absolute source-audio file path in Source audio.
3. Set the prompt, duration, final dimensions, and upscale factor.
4. Select installed models in the shared-model section.
5. Queue the workflow. The final output includes the original audio.

Defaults: 8 seconds; 1920 x 1080 final; 2x latent upscale. H3 internally uses 960 x 544 for pass 1 and 1920 x 1088 for pass 2, then crops to the final dimensions.

This is a normal editable ComfyUI workflow, not an API prompt. It does not change the Builder.
nodes.title: START HERE

widgets_values:
Generate at the lower resolution with the FL2VA I2V base model. The source audio is encoded and locked in the joint audio/video latent. Both seeds remain FIXED so repeated comparisons use the same seeds.

The last_frame sockets are intentionally unconnected, matching the first-frame-only API graph. For an optional last-frame test, connect the same second image to BOTH I2V conditioning nodes.
nodes.title: PASS 1

widgets_values:
Uses the same learned model as Reference to Video 2 Pass:
minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_bf16.safetensors

Only the video latent is upscaled. The original audio latent and its lock are preserved when the streams are rejoined.
nodes.title: LATENT UPSCALE

widgets_values:
Re-encode the FIRST FRAME at the actual upscaled latent dimensions, then refine with the I2V-compatible FL2V Turbo LoRA.

Defaults match the API graph: 8 refinement steps, 0.2 denoise. The Reference-to-Video LoRA must not be substituted here.
